headers.//: consent.js is the tracking gate. It must never be served from a stale cache -- /assets/* is immutable for a year, which is why this file lives at the root instead.

headers.//csp: Still Report-Only, deliberately -- see app/next.config.ts for the full promotion criteria. What changed (audit item 17 finding 8, item 2 finding 3): a report-uri now exists, so violations are collected instead of computed and discarded; the dead Google Fonts and app.tradingsocial.io entries are gone (fonts are self-hosted under /assets/fonts, and the only fetch on this site is /data/posts.json); and img-src is no longer the 'https:' wildcard that silently permitted any image-shaped tracker on any host. www.google.com is allowed because Google Signals is a function of the GA property the business owns and is now gated by Consent Mode. The Meta CAPI Gateway hosts (fh-*.ecs.us-west-2.on.aws and its bded8a3c6ae-*.us-central1.run.app fallback) are deliberately NOT allowed -- keeping them in the reports is how the owner sees them until a decision is made about whether that gateway should exist.
